problem_statement: OpenThread's NCP/Spinel support for DNS-SD service discovery is incomplete. There is no way to serialize or deserialize a service-browser request frame (carrying a service type, an optional sub-type label, an infrastructure network interface index, and a browse callback) on the Spinel link, nor to serialize or deserialize a browse-result frame (carrying a service type, sub-type label, service instance label, TTL, infrastructure interface index, and a callback), and the corresponding property keys are not recognized by the Spinel property table. As a result a host acting as an NCP cannot register a DNS-SD browser or deliver browse results. Provide the Spinel codecs that encode and decode a DNS-SD browser and a DNS-SD browse result, and register the two new DNS-SD property keys, so these frames can be round-tripped and the property names resolve.
